157.description: This vector represents Italian verb stems and inflectional suffixes related to indication and verification.

61.description: This vector represents roots or prefixes related to continuity, persistence, and experience across various languages.

15.description: This feature vector activates on words ending with the "-are" or "-ire" rhyming suffix, particularly in Italian and English terms.
